verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical. Both drop the 'Quiet Hours' book cover, which was the hero image, so the original loses its key visual. Both also shrink the Inkwell & Lantern logo to an illegible speck in the top-left corner and leave the fine print tiny. B's logo looks clipped or garbled ('NOWELL & ANTERN'), which damages the brand mark more than A's. B wraps the body copy more cleanly ('Tea and toast all night' stays on one line), while A breaks it awkwardly before 'and'. I gave A the edge because the logo matters more than the line break.
